text.p: Here are the highlights of stories in the Danish press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
Today's newspapers devoted most of their pages to coverage of Queen Margrethe's silver jubilee celebrations, which began on Tuesday and continue through the weekend.
--- Exports of services have increased strongly within recent years and could make up between 35 and 40 percent of total Danish exports in ten years, the Danish Chamber of Commerce foresees.
--- Tax minister Carsten Koch wants to close a loophole by which banks to defer tax payments by transferring revenue profits to provisions against possible losses.
--- New large retail stores for consumer electronics established in 1996 have lowered price levels by 5-7 percent in all parts of Denmark.

--- A merger between Denmark's third largest bank BG Bank and mortgage lender Nykredit is not imminent, the Nykredit board says, fearing that a merger with much larger BG Bank could harm Nykredit's good corporate spirit.
